title: Game Mastery
description:
Game Mastery is about understanding your chosen game. Level up this badge by completing challenges and learning activities around building game sense, developing game mechanics and securing victories.

Click on the sub-badges below to learn more.

subBadges.title: Advanced Mechanics
subBadges.description: This sub-badge can be earned by successfully performing 3 advances game mechanics under a coaches supervision.

subBadges.title: Analyst
subBadges.info: Break down a recorded match and identify key moments
subBadges.description: You can achieve this badge by attending lesson and analysing your match.

subBadges.title: Average Scorer
subBadges.info: Achieve an average score in 3 matches
subBadges.description: to earn this badge you must achieve an average score in 3 matches, check with your coach what the average score for your chosen game is and make sure to show evidence.

subBadges.title: Endgame Expert
subBadges.description: To earn this badge you must participate fully in a group lesson about end games.

subBadges.title: High Scorer
subBadges.info: Achieve an above average score in 3 matches
subBadges.description: To achieve this badge you must achieve an above average score in 3 matches. Check with your coach to find out what the average score is for your chosen game. Remember and show evidence.

subBadges.title: Loadout Specialist
subBadges.info: Optimize in-game equipment or character selection
subBadges.description: identify which loadout is best for different strategies to gain this sub badge.

subBadges.title: Mentor
subBadges.info: Teach a teammate a key skill or technique
subBadges.description: Team leader can achieve this badge by mentoring teammates.

subBadges.title: Meta Master
subBadges.info: Understand the current game meta including relevant mechanics, items, characters, abilities or challenges.
subBadges.description: This sub-badge is earned by attending a lesson that involves learning about new or relevant items or mechanics in the game.

subBadges.title: MVP
subBadges.info: Play a team match. Achieve the highest score in the team.
subBadges.description: To achieve this sub-badge, you should play a match with some of your team mates and get the highest score in the team. Make sure to show a coach your match results.

subBadges.title: Navigator
subBadges.info: Navigate the map and identify key strategic areas
subBadges.description: You can achieve this badge by participating in a lesson and learning about the in-game map.

subBadges.title: Precision Specialist
subBadges.info: Land a high percentage of accurate moves/shots
subBadges.description: Achieve this badge by shooting and moving with high precision.

subBadges.title: Rank Climber
subBadges.description: Earn this sub-badge by achieving an average rank in game. Check with your coach as to the average rank for your chosen game and remember to show evidence!

subBadges.title: Ranked!
subBadges.description: Earn this badge by achieving a basic rank in game – make sure to show your coach evidence.

subBadges.title: Strategist
subBadges.info: Compare strengths and weaknesses of different game strategies.
subBadges.description: Earn this sub-badge by participating in a lesson about game strategies,

subBadges.title: Trick Shot
subBadges.description: By hitting a trick shot you will achieve this sub badge.

subBadges.title: Victor
subBadges.description: This is the second of a 3 tier badge. To Earn this badge you must win a total of 6 matches and record evidence such as a screenshot or clip.

subBadges.title: Victor
subBadges.description: This is the second of a 3 tier badge. To Earn this badge you must win a total of 10 matches and record evidence such as a screenshot or clip.

title: Team Work
description: Team Work is working together to achieve success. understanding your chosen game. Level up this badge by completing challenges and learning activities around communication, collaboration and player roles.

subBadges.title: Activity Planner
subBadges.description: Plan an activity for your team.

subBadges.title: Cheerleader
subBadges.info: Keep morale high during a match
subBadges.description: Maintain a focused and positive mindset during a match to achieve this sub badge.

subBadges.title: Communicator
subBadges.description: To earn this badge you should participate fully in a group lesson on effective and ineffective communication

subBadges.title: Effective Comms
subBadges.description: Take on good communication with teammates to gain this badge.

subBadges.title: Feedback
subBadges.description: To achieve this badge you should provide a teammate with relevant and useful feedback after a match. This should happen during a team feedback session.

subBadges.title: Feedback
subBadges.info: Recieve positive feedback from a teammate
subBadges.description: This badge is awarded after receiving positive feedback during a team feedback session.

subBadges.title: Feedback
subBadges.description: This is a high value sub-badge that can be achieved by taking feedback from a teammate during a team review session and applying it in a subsequent game.

subBadges.title: Feedback Warrior
subBadges.description: Players can achieve this sub-badge my taking part in lesson.

subBadges.title: Role Adopter
subBadges.info: Have a continuous role for 3 matches
subBadges.description: Teammates take chances of the 3 main player roles to achieve this badge.

subBadges.title: Role Player
subBadges.description: Achieve this badge by attending lesson and know 3 main roles.

subBadges.title: Team Execution
subBadges.description: Get 15 kills with with your team to achieve this sub badge.

subBadges.title: Team Execution
subBadges.description: Get 25 elims with your team to achieve this sub badge.

subBadges.title: Team Leader
subBadges.description: Player will take part in team leader lesson to achieve this sub badge.

subBadges.title: Team Player
subBadges.info: Play 5 matches as part of a team
subBadges.description: You must play 5 matches as part of a team to earn this sub-badge.

subBadges.title: Team Player
subBadges.info: Play 10 matches as part of a team
subBadges.description: You must play 10 matches as part of a team to earn this sub-badge

subBadges.title: Yes Coach
subBadges.info: Coach a team mate through an entire game
subBadges.description: Take on the 1 on 1 coaching activity to receive this sub badge.

title: Personal Development
description: Personal development is understanding our own stengths, weaknesses and goals. Level up this badge by completing learning opportunites and challenges aound practice, mindset, accountability and observing healthy habits in gaming any beyond.

title: Esports Citizen
description:
Game Mastery is about understanding your chosen game. Level up this badge by completing challenges and learning activities around building game sense, developing game mechanics and securing victories.

Click on the sub-badges below to learn more.

subBadges.title: GGWP
subBadges.info: Demonstrate good sportsmanship after a competitive match
subBadges.description: Show that you can apply good sportsmanship after a match to achieve this badge.

subBadges.title: Good Sport
subBadges.info: Understand the importance of sportsmanship in esports
subBadges.description: Achieve this badge by attending session lesson and showing how to be a good sport in esports.

subBadges.title: Good Vibes Only
subBadges.info: Take part in a Fortnite match where you show positive communication, help your teammates, and keep the good vibes going from start to finish.
subBadges.description: Show positive energy, kindness, and respect while gaming. Support your teammates, use encouraging words, and be a great sport — win or lose!

subBadges.title: Know The Rules
subBadges.description: Earn this badge by participating in a group lesson around Academy Rules.
